topic: Buying a rental property with no cash reserves vs holding six months of expenses first (Lennox vs Isolde)

scenes.narration: One vacant month can bankrupt a landlord with no reserves. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard showing a small house with a sign reading VACANT and an empty jar, comic burst banner reads ONE VACANT MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lennox and Isolde both buy a duplex as their first rental.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split clinic panel of man lennox and woman isolde each holding keys to a duplex, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each mortgage payment is nineteen hundred dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a mortgage statement reading NINETEEN HUNDRED MONTHLY, a duplex drawing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lennox spends every dollar on the down payment. Reserves, zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man lennox emptying his savings jar into a down payment, a label reads RESERVES ZERO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Month three, a tenant leaves and the water heater dies the same week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an empty apartment with a moving truck, a water heater leaking, man lennox panicking, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He puts twenty two hundred on a credit card and misses a mortgage payment.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man lennox swiping a card for a water heater, a mortgage notice stamped LATE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Six months in, he sells at a loss just to escape.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a FOR SALE sign on the duplex, a chart showing a loss, man lennox exhausted, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Isolde waits one more year and saves six months of expenses first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman isolde filling a jar labeled SIX MONTHS RESERVES, a calendar flipping a year, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eleven thousand four hundred sits untouched in a separate account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a bank account screen reading ELEVEN THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED, RESERVES ONLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: When her tenant leaves and the roof leaks, the reserve pays. No stress.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman isolde calmly paying a roofer from the reserve account, a stamp reads PAID, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Five years later, Lennox has a loss. Isolde has equity and a refilled reserve.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man lennox with a loss statement, woman isolde beside an equity chart and a full jar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Six months of reserves before any rental. No exceptions. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading SIX MONTHS RESERVES FIRST, a healthy cash flow chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
